local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local ready,done=false,false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 local cuirass=core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c1)
 local greaves=core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c3)
 local inv=Actor.inventory(self)
 if not ready then assert(inv:countOf(cuirass)==1 and inv:countOf(greaves)==1,'Armor missing') ready=true print('Substructure armor ready') end
 local c,g=false,false
 for slot,item in pairs(Actor.getEquipment(self)) do
  if item.recordId==cuirass then c=true end
  if item.recordId==greaves then g=true end
 end
 if c and not done then done=true print('Substructure cuirass equipped') end
end}}}}
